parameter_log_model.strings: sent as text; logged as given, single quotes doubled
parameter_log_model.integers_booleans_floats: sent in binary by psycopg 3 (Int2/Int4/Int8, Bool, Float binary dumpers); logged with the type's text output
parameter_log_model.float8: shortest exact decimal (extra_float_digits=1, pinned in session_options): NaN, Infinity, -Infinity, '-0' for negative zero (observed), Python repr for non-integral finite values below 1e15 or in exponent form. Positive zero, integral values and 1e15 <= |x| < 1e16 have no established form and are refused before any SQL runs
parameter_log_model.observed_basis: the third real run's op7b statements, tests/research_tracks/fixtures/gate_a1_v3_observed.csv

steps: OP-1 operator: start the disposable container with Gate A1's reviewed commands (gate_a1_characterize.py plan); the driver runs no command

OP-2 export batch (Gate A1 operations, unchanged): op0p preflight, op0r empty reset, op2a and op2b exports, op2c cross-check, op9c cleanup, each a tagged session reconciled from the server log; then the whole-batch session audit
OP-2b reviewer: attests the export digest

OP-6i construction batch (not reachable from the command line): op0p preflight, op0r empty reset, op2a re-export bound to the attested server instance and structural digest, then twice op0r seeded reset, op6i typed check, op6f typed read, then op9c cleanup and the whole-batch audit

OP-3a, OP-3, OP-4, OP-5, OP-6f, OP-2d Gate 2A section: each call in a gap between two reader segments (SegmentedRun), each gap audited against the gate2a_audit template. BLOCKED (B1 to B6) and not wired to the command line
